subject.title: improve(agents): avoid duplicate subagent registry write

question: Should a plugin-replaceable task runtime be permitted to synchronously mutate requester-origin metadata that is also stored in a subagent registry record?
rationale: The removed save previously persisted any incidental synchronous mutation after task creation; choosing whether that behavior is supported determines whether the repair should isolate data or retain a post-boundary persistence point.

options.title: Preserve registry isolation
options.body: Recommended: copy or otherwise isolate registry-owned request metadata before task-runtime creation and add a replacement-runtime regression test proving registration persistence remains canonical.

options.title: Declare immutable task inputs
options.body: Document and test that task-runtime implementations must not mutate request metadata, then retain the one-save design under that explicit plugin contract.

options.title: Keep the post-create save
options.body: Retain the trailing best-effort save if compatibility with existing mutable task runtimes is more important than removing the duplicate snapshot write.

recommendation.title: Preserve registry isolation
recommendation.body: Recommended: copy or otherwise isolate registry-owned request metadata before task-runtime creation and add a replacement-runtime regression test proving registration persistence remains canonical.

likelyOwner.reason: This person introduced the adjacent task-executor ordering that makes the persistence-boundary choice observable.
